title: Jamaican Coconut Curry Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the warm spices of Jamaica with the richness of coconut and the creaminess of curry. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder, allspice, and ginger. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and stir in the coconut milk.
Simmer the sauce over low heat for 5 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
